title: THE PERSISTENT FEED
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the way different messages come in at different places is messy and needs to be made consistent, maybe a persistent feed like WoW. There is now one feed at the bottom left, above the body corner: the last ten lines, the newest at the bottom, each full bright for six seconds and then dimmed to 35 percent, where it stays until a newer line pushes it out (the last forty are kept). Everything the raid says goes in, with a small glyph and a colour for its kind: pickups in their rarity colour and counted, alerts, objectives, teammate lines, kills (yours, a teammate and machines and pillagers killing each other), medals and money, power-ups. The controls list stands above it. The old places still show for now; the next builds move them out.
now: There is now one persistent feed at the bottom left that takes every raid line, newest at the bottom.
